title: PART 5 / PLATE IT FORWARD
goal: Revisit story evidence and the shared challenge, recognize growth, and identify learning to carry into future teamwork.
outcomes: Reflect on the story and investigation using evidence.
Identify personal and team growth from the shared challenge.
Name a friendship or teamwork choice to carry forward.
focus: Look for thoughtful reflections linked to story evidence and the teamwork choices students made during the challenge.
assessment: Investigation Notes: Look for considered perspectives and examples from the story or challenge. Chosen reflection: Look for a specific contribution, team success, and next step. Formative only; no right answers.

rows.text: Slides 1–3 — Discuss the reflection prompts and revisit the clue tracker image.
Could Maddie and Zoe’s friendship recover? Why or why not?
Compare the clues students found with the displayed tracker. Invite different perspectives; note clues they missed or reconsidered.
Students reflect on friendship recovery, team successes and struggles, and responses to mistakes, pressure, or different opinions.
Which teamwork skill mattered most during your challenge?

rows.description: Return to Part 1 K and W responses; complete L and S. Compare what has changed.

rows.text: Record what the team did and learned, how members contributed, one big win, and next steps. Keep it brief and low-pressure.
What is one teamwork choice you will carry into your next challenge?
Invite a brief share or written exit response; celebrate effort and growth. A separate celebration is optional.
